driver-gloves-brocade-flowers.name: ★ Driver Gloves | Brocade Flowers
driver-gloves-brocade-flowers.desc: These driving gloves offer protection from the elements while still maintaining tactile sensation.

aug-surveillance.name: AUG | Surveillance
aug-surveillance.desc:
Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. A custom paint job of a map pattern overlayed with a bird's eye HUD has been applied.

Target acquired

bayonet-doppler-phase-1.name: ★ Bayonet | Doppler
bayonet-doppler-phase-1.desc:
Relatively unchanged in its design since World War II, the bayonet still retains a place in modern military strategy. Bayonet charges have continued to be effective as recently as the second Gulf War and the war in Afghanistan. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

cz75-auto-the-fuschia-is-now.name: CZ75-Auto | The Fuschia Is Now
cz75-auto-the-fuschia-is-now.desc: A fully automatic variant of the CZ75, the CZ75-Auto is the ideal short-term choice for turning the tables and gaining your opponents weapon. But with very little ammo in the magazine, strong trigger discipline is required. It has been painted with a chrome base coat and candied in transparent fuschia and charcoal anodized effect paint.

cz75-auto-silver.name: CZ75-Auto | Silver
cz75-auto-silver.desc:
A fully automatic variant of the CZ75, the CZ75-Auto is the ideal short-term choice for turning the tables and gaining your opponents weapon. But with very little ammo in the magazine, strong trigger discipline is required. It has been painted with a chrome base coat and candied in transparent silver anodized effect paint.

There is beauty in simplicity - Franz Kriegeld, Phoenix Tactician

cz75-auto-victoria.name: CZ75-Auto | Victoria
cz75-auto-victoria.desc: A fully automatic variant of the CZ75, the CZ75-Auto is the ideal short-term choice for turning the tables and gaining your opponents weapon. But with very little ammo in the magazine, strong trigger discipline is required. It has been decorated with gold accents and hand-engraved with a scroll pattern.

cz75-auto-tuxedo.name: CZ75-Auto | Tuxedo
cz75-auto-tuxedo.desc:
A fully automatic variant of the CZ75, the CZ75-Auto is the ideal short-term choice for turning the tables and gaining your opponents weapon. But with very little ammo in the magazine, strong trigger discipline is required. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a black and white color scheme.

For when combat is a black tie affair

desert-eagle-kumicho-dragon.name: Desert Eagle | Kumicho Dragon
desert-eagle-kumicho-dragon.desc:
As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. Dragons have been laser-etched onto the slide and grip.

I'm a big fan of your work Yukako, we should talk... -Huxley, The Competition

desert-eagle-the-daily-deagle.name: Desert Eagle | The Daily Deagle
desert-eagle-the-daily-deagle.desc:
As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. A grayscale pattern has been applied.

From the pages of your favorite graphic novel

dual-berettas-anodized-navy.name: Dual Berettas | Anodized Navy
dual-berettas-anodized-navy.desc: Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. It has been painted with a chrome base coat and candied in transparent navy blue anodized effect paint.

dual-berettas-retribution.name: Dual Berettas | Retribution
dual-berettas-retribution.desc: Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. It has been custom painted in a military themed design.

dual-berettas-black-limba.name: Dual Berettas | Black Limba
dual-berettas-black-limba.desc:
Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. This memento from Agency has a dark patina and grips of black limba wood.

Where classic construction meets modern aesthetics

famas-yeti-camo.name: FAMAS | Yeti Camo
famas-yeti-camo.desc:
A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. A blue and grey camo pattern has been applied.

Arctic camo, eh?

famas-palm.name: FAMAS | Palm
famas-palm.desc: A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. It has been spray-painted using cardboard cutouts, fine mesh, and palm leaves as stencils.

g3sg1-arctic-camo.name: G3SG1 | Arctic Camo
g3sg1-arctic-camo.desc:
The pricy G3SG1 lowers movement speed considerably but compensates with a higher rate of fire than other sniper rifles. It has been painted using an arctic camo hydrographic.

Snow is cold; death is colder

galil-ar-phoenix-blacklight.name: Galil AR | Phoenix Blacklight
galil-ar-phoenix-blacklight.desc:
A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. A multicolored pattern of various Phoenix Connexion graffiti has been applied.

"We will dance on your graves!"

glock-18-bunsen-burner.name: Glock-18 | Bunsen Burner
glock-18-bunsen-burner.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has been given a blue patina which has been polished off parts of the slide to result in a graphic flame design.

KNOCK KNOCK

glock-18-groundwater.name: Glock-18 | Groundwater
glock-18-groundwater.desc: The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in an olive drab color scheme.

p2000-chainmail.name: P2000 | Chainmail
p2000-chainmail.desc:
Accurate and controllable, the German-made P2000 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents. It has been painted with a semi-transparent hydrographic in a chainmail pattern over a silver base coat.

Of all the members of The Phoenix, none are more loyal to Valeria than her bodyguard Naomi

p2000-dispatch.name: P2000 | Dispatch
p2000-dispatch.desc:
Accurate and controllable, the German-made P2000 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents. A multicolored pattern of randomized numbers has been applied.

Numbers don't lie, but I do

p2000-oceanic.name: P2000 | Oceanic
p2000-oceanic.desc:
Accurate and controllable, the German-made P2000 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents. It has been given a black base coat then accented with blue designs.

Has anyone heard from Kotaro or Carmen? - Felix Riley, Commanding Officer

falchion-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-1.name: ★ Falchion Knife | Gamma Doppler
falchion-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-1.desc: A modern homage to a falchion sword, this clip point blade has a curved edge. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

falchion-knife-stained.name: ★ Falchion Knife | Stained
falchion-knife-stained.desc:
A modern homage to a falchion sword, this clip point blade has a curved edge. It has been given a forced patina using lemon and mustard dripped onto the surface.

If you think it's messy now, wait until you see it under a blacklight

flip-knife-doppler-phase-2.name: ★ Flip Knife | Doppler
flip-knife-doppler-phase-2.desc:
Flip knives sport a Persian-style back-swept blade with an acute point.  While the point itself may be fragile, the overall design of the flip knife's design is surprisingly durable. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

flip-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-2.name: ★ Flip Knife | Gamma Doppler
flip-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-2.desc: Flip knives sport a Persian-style back-swept blade with an acute point.  While the point itself may be fragile, the overall design of the flip knife's design is surprisingly durable. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

flip-knife-doppler-ruby.name: ★ Flip Knife | Doppler
flip-knife-doppler-ruby.desc:
Flip knives sport a Persian-style back-swept blade with an acute point.  While the point itself may be fragile, the overall design of the flip knife's design is surprisingly durable. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

navaja-knife-doppler-phase-4.name: ★ Navaja Knife | Doppler
navaja-knife-doppler-phase-4.desc:
This marble-enamel-handled flip knife conceals a small but viciously tapered blade. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

navaja-knife-boreal-forest.name: ★ Navaja Knife | Boreal Forest
navaja-knife-boreal-forest.desc:
This marble-enamel-handled flip knife conceals a small but viciously tapered blade. It has been painted using a forest camouflage hydrographic.

The woods can be a dangerous place... never travel alone

karambit-ultraviolet.name: ★ Karambit | Ultraviolet
karambit-ultraviolet.desc:
With its curved blade mimicking a tiger's claw, the karambit was developed as part of the southeast Asian martial discipline of silat. The knife is typically used with a reverse grip, with the finger ring on the index finger. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a black and purple color scheme.

Elegant design paired with brutal intent

kukri-knife-stained.name: ★ Kukri Knife | Stained
kukri-knife-stained.desc:
Used in traditional rituals, such as weddings or stabbings. It has been given a forced patina using lemon and mustard dripped onto the surface.

If you think it's messy now, wait until you see it under a blacklight

m9-bayonet-gamma-doppler-emerald.name: ★ M9 Bayonet | Gamma Doppler
m9-bayonet-gamma-doppler-emerald.desc: This is the M-9 bayonet.  Originally intended to be mounted on a rifle, it is also well suited to close-quarters combat. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

nomad-knife-doppler-phase-4.name: ★ Nomad Knife | Doppler
nomad-knife-doppler-phase-4.desc:
This ergonomic tactical hunting lock-blade knife features composite handle inserts and a broad, sturdy blade, useful for cutting and prying apart material. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

nomad-knife-boreal-forest.name: ★ Nomad Knife | Boreal Forest
nomad-knife-boreal-forest.desc:
This ergonomic tactical hunting lock-blade knife features composite handle inserts and a broad, sturdy blade, useful for cutting and prying apart material. It has been painted using a forest camouflage hydrographic.

The woods can be a dangerous place... never travel alone

shadow-daggers-doppler-phase-1.name: ★ Shadow Daggers | Doppler
shadow-daggers-doppler-phase-1.desc:
Designed for efficient brutality, using a push dagger is as simple as throwing a punch or two. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

stiletto-knife-stained.name: ★ Stiletto Knife | Stained
stiletto-knife-stained.desc:
Historically a focal point of contention and even regulation, this Italian-style stiletto switchblade knife features a spring-loaded blade that can be deployed almost instantly with the push of a release catch. It has been given a forced patina using lemon and mustard dripped onto the surface.

If you think it's messy now, wait until you see it under a blacklight

bowie-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-3.name: ★ Bowie Knife | Gamma Doppler
bowie-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-3.desc: This full-tang sawback Bowie knife is designed for heavy use in brutal survival situations. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

bowie-knife-marble-fade.name: ★ Bowie Knife | Marble Fade
bowie-knife-marble-fade.desc:
This full-tang sawback Bowie knife is designed for heavy use in brutal survival situations. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated in three colors.

The blade is made of many colors, but soon it all looks red

bowie-knife-blue-steel.name: ★ Bowie Knife | Blue Steel
bowie-knife-blue-steel.desc:
This full-tang sawback Bowie knife is designed for heavy use in brutal survival situations. It has been cold blued.

This is the malbec of weapon design - Booth, Arms Dealer

bowie-knife-bright-water.name: ★ Bowie Knife | Bright Water
bowie-knife-bright-water.desc:
This full-tang sawback Bowie knife is designed for heavy use in brutal survival situations. It has been painted using a blue camo hydrographic.

Ours is a world of intrigue...but sometimes camouflage is meant to be seen - Booth, Arms Dealer

huntsman-knife-tiger-tooth.name: ★ Huntsman Knife | Tiger Tooth
huntsman-knife-tiger-tooth.desc:
A knife designed for modern tactical uses, the blade is well suited for a range of both combat and utilitarian needs.  The unique Tanto point allows for maximum penetration through even the toughest of surfaces. It has been anodized orange and hand-etched in a tiger stripe pattern.

Like the tiger it is rare... like the tiger it is deadly...

m4a1-s-atomic-alloy.name: M4A1-S | Atomic Alloy
m4a1-s-atomic-alloy.desc: With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. It has been anodized black and orange.

mac-10-snow-splash.name: MAC-10 | Snow Splash
mac-10-snow-splash.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. A grayscale pattern featuring sharp, angular designs has been applied.

Unflinching

mag-7-foresight.name: MAG-7 | Foresight
mag-7-foresight.desc:
The CT-exclusive Mag-7 delivers a devastating amount of damage at close range. Its rapid magazine-style reloads make it a great tactical choice. This custom paint job features an octopus, asked to predict the outcome of a match, reaching for the "win" tablet.

I've got a good feeling about this...

mp5-sd-bamboo-garden.name: MP5-SD | Bamboo Garden
mp5-sd-bamboo-garden.desc:
Often imitated but never equaled, the iconic MP5 is perhaps the most versatile and popular SMG in the world. This SD variant features an integrated silencer, making an already formidable weapon whisper-quiet. It has been painted with a hydrographic of brush-painted bamboo.

Insert shoot pun here

mp7-powercore.name: MP7 | Powercore
mp7-powercore.desc:
Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. It has been custom painted with a green base and yellow highlights.

Rule No. 2 – Never clash in public

mp9-green-plaid.name: MP9 | Green Plaid
mp9-green-plaid.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. It has been painted with a hydrographic in a taupe and blue-green plaid pattern.

It's not a bagpipe, but it plays a song before every funeral

negev-power-loader.name: Negev | Power Loader
negev-power-loader.desc:
The Negev is a beast that can keep the enemy at bay with its pin-point supressive fire, provided you have the luxury of time to gain control over it. It has been custom painted with a hydrographic reminiscent of heavy machinery.

Feared by Queens.  Beloved by Bishops.

nova-forest-leaves.name: Nova | Forest Leaves
nova-forest-leaves.desc: The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. It has been spray-painted using leaves as stencils.

p250-supernova.name: P250 | Supernova
p250-supernova.desc: A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. It has been painted with a hydrographic in a cosmic pattern with concentric circles.

p250-facility-draft.name: P250 | Facility Draft
p250-facility-draft.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. It has been covered in a red hydrographic pattern resembling a nuclear power plant.

Creating energy from atoms

p90-grim.name: P90 | Grim
p90-grim.desc:
Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. It has been given a hydrographic of murderous specters, then dry brushed with green accents.

Imogen... are you selling me a gun or a velvet poster? – Rona Sabri, Rising Star

p90-trigon.name: P90 | Trigon
p90-trigon.desc:
Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. It has been custom painted in contrasting orange, grey and black.

Become a human typhoon

p90-cocoa-rampage.name: P90 | Cocoa Rampage
p90-cocoa-rampage.desc:
Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. An olive and gold-colored hydrographic pattern of cartoon dinosaurs has been applied.

Dinosaurs and aliens and comets, oh my!

r8-revolver-crimson-web.name: R8 Revolver | Crimson Web
r8-revolver-crimson-web.desc:
The R8 Revolver delivers a highly accurate and powerful round at the expense of a lengthy trigger-pull. Firing rapidly by fanning the hammer may be the best option when point-blank stopping power is required. It has been painted using a spider web-patterned hydrographic over a red base coat and finished with a semi-gloss topcoat.

Be careful where you walk, you never know where the web is spread

r8-revolver-cobalt-grip.name: R8 Revolver | Cobalt Grip
r8-revolver-cobalt-grip.desc:
The R8 Revolver delivers a highly accurate and powerful round at the expense of a lengthy trigger-pull. Firing rapidly by fanning the hammer may be the best option when point-blank stopping power is required. A blue pattern has been painted on the grip of this R8.

Get a grip!

sawed-off-fusion.name: Sawed-Off | Fusion
sawed-off-fusion.desc:
The classic Sawed-Off deals very heavy close-range damage, but with its low accuracy, high spread and slow rate of fire, you'd better kill what you hit. It has been custom painted with a black and gold design. Additional details are revealed in different lighting conditions.

Eye've seen things...

sawed-off-jungle-thicket.name: Sawed-Off | Jungle Thicket
sawed-off-jungle-thicket.desc:
The classic Sawed-Off deals very heavy close-range damage, but with its low accuracy, high spread and slow rate of fire, you'd better kill what you hit. It has been spray-painted with dark green palm fronds over a jungle colored camo.

From Aztec with love

ssg-08-fever-dream.name: SSG 08 | Fever Dream
ssg-08-fever-dream.desc:
The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. It has been custom painted with manic pink, blue, and purple drawings on a black base.

H@@HH@H@H@HA!!

tec-9-decimator.name: Tec-9 | Decimator
tec-9-decimator.desc:
An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. It has been custom painted with totally radical blue and pink highlights.

Available for 4 easy payments of $124.95!

usp-s-target-acquired.name: USP-S | Target Acquired
usp-s-target-acquired.desc:
A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. A custom paint job of a map pattern overlayed with a bird's eye HUD has been applied.

Target acquired

usp-s-ancient-visions.name: USP-S | Ancient Visions
usp-s-ancient-visions.desc:
A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. A green and red pattern featuring intricate linework and ancient creatures has been applied.

The privilege is yours

xm1014-frost-borre.name: XM1014 | Frost Borre
xm1014-frost-borre.desc:
The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. A Norse inspired pattern of silver interlocking rings has been applied.

Not all clouds bring rain

xm1014-calicamo.name: XM1014 | CaliCamo
xm1014-calicamo.desc:
The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. It has been painted using a VariCamo patterned hydrographic.

Rebuilding only comes in the wake of destruction

xm1014-blue-spruce.name: XM1014 | Blue Spruce
xm1014-blue-spruce.desc: The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a moss color scheme.

xm1014-run-run-run.name: XM1014 | Run Run Run
xm1014-run-run-run.desc:
The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. It has been painted to resemble well-traveled train cars.

Last stop!
